top_signal.title: Free Marketing Makover Casting Call
top_signal.summary: SMALL BUSINESS OWNERS: I’m looking for one business that needs a marketing makeover.   I’m looking for one small business that will let me rethink its branding, website and marketing at no cost—and document it for our soical portfolio    Depending on what the business needs, the makeover could include:   • Branding and messaging  • Website or e-commerce improvements  • Social media and content strategy  • Marketing campaign ideas  • A practical growth plan   There is no purchase requirement and no obligation to hire me afterward. The selected business would need to be comfortable appearing on camera and allowing us to share the process and results publicly.   Interested? Post the name of your business with you URL and my team will review. Thanks!       submitted by     /u/viciplusnelly       [link]       [comments]
